say: Namaste, main Goel Small Finance Bank se Meera bol rahi hoon. Kya meri baat Ujjwal Goel ji se ho rahi hai?
speak: नमस्ते, मैं Goel Small Finance Bank से मीरा बोल रही हूँ। क्या मेरी बात उज्ज्वल गोएल जी से हो रही है?

text: Yes, I am Ujjwal Goel. I can pay tomorrow.

say: Ye call training ke liye record ki jaa rahi hai. Main keval aapse hindi mein hi vartalab kar skti hu. Dusri bhasha ke liye main aapko hmare uplabdh agent se connect krva skti hu. Kya aap ye krna chahenge?
speak: ये call training के लिए record की जा रही है। मैं केवल आपसे हिंदी में ही वार्तालाप कर सकती हूँ। दूसरी भाषा के लिए मैं आपको हमारे उपलब्ध agent से connect करवा सकती हूँ। क्या आप ये करना चाहेंगे?

checks.label: Confirmed it was the borrower before saying anything about the loan
No threats, shaming, legal action, or mention of family or employer
Never said a payment had arrived or 'ho gaya' without system confirmation
Any part payment offered was at least the minimum (50% of the EMI)
At most one payment link was sent
No promises about waivers, calls stopping, or credit-record outcomes
Stated only the customer facts and policy notes given; no invented numbers or reasons
Dates and amounts read back correctly against what the borrower said
One question at a time, short turns, polite register (aap, ji)

checks.note: The call ended on an unanswered language question, with no amount, date, how-to-pay or polite close, and Meera never acknowledged his 'pay tomorrow'.
checks.label: Ended with a clear next step (amount, date, how) or a polite close
checks.quote: Ye call training ke liye record ki jaa rahi hai. Main keval aapse hindi mein hi vartalab kar skti hu. Dusri bhasha ke liye main aapko hmare uplabdh agent se connect krva skti hu. Kya aap ye krna chahenge?

review.summary: Meera confirmed she was speaking to Ujjwal Goel, and he said in English that he can pay tomorrow. Meera then gave the recording and Hindi-only notice and offered an English-speaking agent, and the transcript ends there. The EMI, amount and payment method were never discussed, so there is no usable commitment.
review.nextStep: Call back, using an English-speaking agent if he prefers, to confirm the EMI amount, the date (he said 'tomorrow', 10 Oct) and how he will pay.
ticketReasons: Borrower replied in English; language support offered but not answered
